cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(fixture_cmake CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
add_library(adder src/adder.cpp)
target_include_directories(adder PUBLIC src)
add_executable(fixture_app src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(fixture_app PRIVATE adder)
enable_testing()
add_executable(adder_test tests/adder_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(adder_test PRIVATE adder)
add_test(NAME adder_test COMMAND adder_test)
